summary: School district expresses concern about preserving E-Rate funding to maintain network infrastructure and avoid budget cuts.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, schools would have to delay network infrastructure upgrades and consider reducing staff positions.
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, we would have to delay vital network infrastructure upgrades. Services would have to be reduced to the absorb the additional cost of what E-Rate was funding for our school district. Depending on how large the cuts were we would have to consider reducing teacher/staffing positions to make up for the shortfall.
